name: Alrighty
long_description: Alrighty is a Mac mail app that fixes email. Anyone with your address can reach you, so most inboxes fill up with cold outreach, sales pitches, newsletters nobody reads and privacy-policy updates, and the few emails that matter get buried. Alrighty gets that mail out of your way and lets the AI you already use keep track of the conversations that matter. It works with the Gmail, iCloud and Outlook accounts you already have, and every AI feature is one you choose to turn on.
one_liner: Email that only shows you what matters.
